under me those that rose up{H6965} against me. 40 Thou hast also made{H5414} mine enemies{H341} turn their backs{H6203} unto me, That I might cut off{H6789} them that hate{H8130} me. 41 They cried,{H7768} but there was none to save;{H3467} Even unto Jehovah,{H3068} but he answered{H6030} them not. 42 Then did I beat{H7833} them small as the dust{H6083} before{H6440} the wind;{H7307} I did cast them out{H7324} as the mire{H2916} of the streets.{H2351} 43 Thou hast delivered{H6403} me from the strivings{H7379} of the people;{H5971} Thou hast made{H7760} me the head{H7218} of the nations:{H1471} A people{H5971} whom I have not known{H3045} shall serve{H5647} me. 44 As soon as they hear{H8088} of me they shall obey{H8085} me; The foreigners{H1121} shall submit{H3584} themselves unto me. 45 The foreigners{H1121} shall fade away,{H5034} And shall come trembling{H2727} out of their close places.{H4526} 46 Jehovah{H3068} liveth;{H2416} And blessed{H1288} be my rock;{H6697} And exalted{H7311} be the God{H430} of my salvation,{H3468} 47 Even the God{H410} that executeth vengeance{H5414} for me, And subdueth{H1696} peoples{H5971} under me. 48 He rescueth{H6403} me from mine enemies;{H341} Yea, thou liftest me up{H7311} above them that rise up{H6965} against me; Thou deliverest{H5337} me from the violent{H2555} man.{H376} 49 Therefore I will give thanks{H3034} unto thee, O Jehovah,{H3068} among the nations,{H1471} And will sing praises{H2167} unto thy name.{H8034} 50 Great{H1431} deliverance{H3444} giveth he to his king,{H4428} And showeth{H6213} lovingkindness{H2617} to his anointed,{H4899} To David{H1732} and to his seed,{H2233} for{H5704} evermore.{H5769}
